name: secure-credential-bridge
description: Run read-only SSH queries without prompts; confirm writes or explicitly preauthorize a test host alias, without exposing credentials.

interface.shortDescription: Controlled SSH, email, and PostgreSQL access.
interface.longDescription: A local MCP bridge for read-only SSH queries, Chinese-purpose confirmation for other commands, optional all-command preauthorization per test host alias, reviewed email drafts, and named read-only PostgreSQL queries. Credentials stay local.
capabilities: Read-only SSH queries, confirmed writes, and explicit test-host preauthorization
defaultPrompt: Run a read-only SSH query or review a remote change
Run a named read-only database query
